correctness.rationale: Reflecting a completed +/- excursion preserves its p^up q^down weight because its up and down counts agree. Conditional on absolute path, the completed excursion signs are fair and independent; for any terminal sign the bijection between excursion signs and crossing flags yields iid Bernoulli(1/2) marks. The exact first-return generating function F_p(z)=1-sqrt(1-4pqz) and renewal survival Q=(1-F)/(1-z) prove the bivariate formula. In the critical drift window the clock Laplace exponent sqrt(a^2+2lambda) follows from sqrt(n)(1-F_{p_n}(exp(-2lambda/n))) and the inverse local-time normalization agrees at a=0; Donsker for independent fair marks and continuous composition yields W_{L^(a)}. Exact enumeration of bounded paths confirms the conditional law, not the functional limit.

final_claim: Conditional on the full absolute-value path of a Bernoulli(p) walk through time 2m+1, each of K_{2m} completed excursions generates an independent fair sign-transition, so C_{2m+1}|abs(path)~Bin(K_{2m},1/2), with the displayed exact bivariate return/crossing generating function. In p_n=(1+a/sqrt(n))/2, (K/sqrt(n),(2C-K)/n^(1/4)) converges jointly to drifted Brownian zero-local-time and an independent Brownian motion evaluated at that local time.
limitations: Exact finite law for odd horizon via completed returns; functional convergence for p_n=(1+a/sqrt n)/2 with fixed a; not independent W and path endpoint jointly, no rates or arbitrary increment laws.
